title: Daily Digest B: Honors + Praise (Tue Nov 17)
parts:
🏆 DEVYDOSE DAILY BUZZ | Week 12 honors

Three board WRs are Biletnikoff semifinalists, the No. 1 RB on the board grabbed another ACC honor, and a Notre Dame freshman is making history 🧵👇

🏅 BILETNIKOFF SEMIFINALISTS (via On3)

• Malachi Toney | Miami | SO, 4⭐ | #2 WR
  🩹 Out after ankle surgery (11/5)
• Jeremiah Smith | Ohio State | JR, 5⭐ | #1 WR
• Carlos Hernandez | Wake Forest | SR | #43 WR (preseason: #158)

🔥 NATE SHEPPARD | RB | Duke | SO, 4⭐ | #1 RB (preseason: #32)

He's the ACC Running Back of the Week again (via On3).

Also: Steve Sarkisian says "a better version" of Texas WR Cam Coleman (#13 WR) is coming (via On3).

🍀 JONAZ WALTON | RB | Notre Dame | FR, 4⭐ | #25 RB (preseason: #34)

247Sports calls him college football's most productive freshman RB, and On3 says he's running into Notre Dame history.

Which of these names finishes the year highest on the board? 👇
